about.heading: Building real-world systems that matter
paragraphs: I'm a full-stack developer based in Nairobi, Kenya, specializing in production-grade web systems.
I've shipped 7+ live platforms spanning ERP, LMS, talent marketplaces, booking systems, fintech, and data tools.
I bring both engineering depth and design sensibility to every project — from database architecture to polished UIs.
